_comment: Face-Off arena geometry — the SINGLE source of truth for both the client render (ArenaScene.tsx) and the server's collision/hitscan model (apps/api/src/services/arena_server.rs, which embeds this exact file at compile time via include_str!). Previously these were two hand-copied literal arrays that had to be kept in sync manually; this file replaces both. Frozen output of generateRoom(0, 0, seedFromString('valor-faceoff')) in apps/web/src/engine/fps/endless.ts (CRATE_LINE cover archetype, depth 17), recentred so the room's midpoint sits at world origin, with the far wall's chain doorway replaced by a solid cap so this is one sealed room. Each box: x/z = centre position, w/d = full extent on X/Z, h = height from y=0.
